outgoing.name: Charles Dickens
outgoing.excerpt: In 1835, Charles Dickens stayed in Ipswich and used it as a setting for scenes in his novel The Pickwick Papers.

outgoing.name: Henry VIII of England
outgoing.excerpt: One of Henry VIII's closest political allies, he founded a college in the town in 1528, which is now known as Ipswich School.

outgoing.name: Horatio Nelson, 1st Viscount Nelson
outgoing.excerpt: In 1797 Lord and Lady Nelson moved to Ipswich, and in 1800 Lord Nelson was appointed High Steward of Ipswich.
